name: base_sdk
_comment: base/nextjs is the shared kernel (ADR-005): unlike domain SDKs whose installable content root is templates/, its content root is src/ (mirroring base/dart/lib/src). Next.js has no package mechanism, so kernel modules reach hosts by file copy: installs points at src/services directly and lands the whole kernel services surface at app/services/base/, imported by hosts and by other SDKs' copied files as '@/app/services/base/...'.
